changes: Local character limits remain unchanged; a schema-derived per-field character budget and shorter action/camera target are sent to the authoring provider.
Completed JSON candidates are preserved even when local validation fails; existing size/path/hash controls are reused.
Private candidate records bind provider, attempt, request sequence, profile, topic, duration, selected settings, reference and episode budget.
Authenticated read-only preview and CSRF/Origin-protected free recovery validate every original local schema, timing, continuity and prompt rule.
Explicit review modal supports action/camera character counters and advanced full-object editing; cancel/read/recover do not call a provider.
Original candidate bytes and prior cost/attempt records are retained after successful edited recovery. No automatic truncation or retry.
